_about: Fictional resumes and job postings with human labels for evaluating SkillSync's code-based matching (services/parserService.ts). Labels describe what a reviewer would extract or judge, independent of what the code does. Skills use the canonical names from KNOWN_SKILLS; expected_years null means debatable, so not scored.

resumes.text: Final-year BS Computer Science student (2022 – 2026) at a university in Lahore. Projects: a sentiment classifier with scikit-learn and pandas, and an image classifier in PyTorch. Comfortable with Python, NumPy, Matplotlib and SQL. Currently pursuing internships in machine learning.

Frontend developer with 1 year of experience building React and Next.js apps in TypeScript. UI styling with Tailwind, state management with Redux, deployments on Vercel. Integrated REST APIs from a Node backend.
Backend engineer, 4 years of experience. Built FastAPI and Django services on PostgreSQL and Redis, with Celery for background jobs. Docker, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions CI/CD on AWS.

Senior data engineer with 8 years of experience. Designs ETL pipelines with Airflow, Spark and Kafka, and models data in dbt on Snowflake and BigQuery. Python and SQL daily. Mentors juniors and leads cross-functional projects.

AI engineer, 2 years of experience shipping LLM apps. RAG pipelines with LangChain and pgvector, OpenAI and Gemini APIs, prompt engineering and model evaluation. FastAPI backends deployed with Docker on GCP.

Former high-school maths teacher (2015 – 2023) moving into data analytics. Completed a data analytics certificate: SQL, Tableau and Power BI dashboards, basic Python with pandas. Strong communication and stakeholder management.
DevOps Engineer, Cloudbase — Mar 2020 – Feb 2025. Terraform and Helm on Kubernetes, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB), Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines, Linux and bash scripting. On call for production.
Staff engineer with 10+ years of experience. Leads a team building a Node.js and TypeScript platform with React frontends, GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL and Redis. Owns architecture and code review.
Mobile developer, 1 year of experience with Flutter and Dart, plus some Kotlin. Firebase authentication and Firestore. Published two apps.
PhD candidate in NLP (2021 – present). Publications on transformers and BERT fine-tuning; experiments in PyTorch and Hugging Face. Teaching assistant for a deep learning course.
Automation specialist, 3 years of experience. Builds n8n and Zapier workflows, webhooks and API integrations for e-commerce clients, plus Retell AI voice agents. Reports in HubSpot.
Data scientist with 3 years of experience in feature engineering, scikit-learn and XGBoost models, and A/B test analysis in Python and R. Dashboards in Looker.
Junior web developer (fresh graduate). JavaScript, HTML and CSS; small Express backends with MongoDB. Learning Docker.

Cloud architect with 12 years of experience across Azure and AWS. Designs serverless systems (Azure Functions, Lambda) with Terraform and Kubernetes, and Azure OpenAI integrations. Strong stakeholder management and project management.
Java developer, 5 years of experience with Spring Boot microservices, Kafka, MySQL and Docker, in an Agile Scrum team.
Digital marketer (2018 – 2024) learning AI automation: built a GPT-4 chatbot with the OpenAI API and n8n, and SEO reports with Python. Experienced with Google Ads, Meta Ads and HubSpot.
Python developer with 1 year of experience: Flask REST APIs, SQLite and PostgreSQL, pytest. Basic Docker.
Senior ML engineer, 7 years of experience. Productionised deep learning models with TensorFlow and PyTorch, MLOps on Kubernetes, model evaluation, and quantization for faster inference.
Real-time systems engineer, 4 years of experience with WebRTC, WebSockets and Twilio voice; Node.js services on AWS.
Data analyst, 2 years of experience. SQL and Power BI, data analysis for retail sales, some Python with pandas.
